# addons wow 3.3.5a — portable skill 1.0.0

A reusable Codex/assistant skill distilled from the Dejunk-WotLK project and its
pinned original-client research. **This is a skill package, not an addon update.**

## Downloads

- `addons-wow-3-3-5a-v1.0.0.zip`: portable folder bundle.
- `addons-wow-3-3-5a-v1.0.0.skill`: the same verified ZIP payload for tools that
  support `.skill` archives. Use ZIP/manual extraction if your product does not.
- `SHA256SUMS.txt`: artifact checksums.

## Install

Extract the complete `addons-wow-3-3-5a` folder into your assistant's supported
skills directory. For Codex project skills use
`.agents/skills/addons-wow-3-3-5a/`; user-scope locations depend on the product.
Refresh/restart discovery if necessary, then invoke `$addons-wow-3-3-5a`.
For another assistant, supply SKILL.md and its relevant reference files.
Installation does not guarantee immediate registration in an already-open session.

## Included

- Original 3.3.5a / build 12340 / Interface 30300 / Lua 5.1 development workflow.
- Legacy API, UI, Escape/drop/input/layering/cache and transaction lessons.
- Testing, evidence, licensing and release checklists.
- Dejunk-specific case study with explicit unresolved parity limitations.
- Pinned source links, hash manifest and historical research/API inventory.
- A read-only starter addon, portable TOC/XML auditor and deterministic packager.
- Seven offline tool regressions, Persian installation guide and optional agent UI metadata.

The skill's own documentation/tools/template are MIT-licensed. Referenced upstream
sources retain their own licenses; no raw Blizzard client code or credentials
are bundled. Historical proposals and unverified category mappings are identified.

اصلی 3.3.5a است. این دانلود خودِ افزونهٔ بازی نیست. ZIP را باز کنید و پوشهٔ اسکیل
را در مسیر skills محصول مقصد قرار دهید؛ در Codex پروژه معمولاً `.agents/skills/`

باگ‌های واقعی، ابزار بررسی/بسته‌بندی و نمونهٔ فقط‌خواندنی داخل بسته هستند.
